name: Barbell Squat Jerk
steps: Stand tall with a barbell racked across your front shoulders, hands slightly wider than shoulder width, and feet hip-width apart.
Brace your core, keep your torso vertical, and dip quickly straight down a few inches at the knees.
Drive explosively upward through your legs to launch the bar, then drop rapidly beneath it into a deep squat with arms locked overhead.
Stabilize the bar overhead, stand all the way up cleanly, and lower the bar safely back to your shoulders.
tips: Keep the bar balanced directly over your midfoot as you catch and stand from the deep squat.
Press actively upward into the bar with completely locked elbows during the catch.
